usedFor: A new buyer mentioned in a Slack channel becomes a Repliers client with tags.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Client” in Repliers
bestTemplate.why: The trigger is pushed as the message lands, and the action takes contact details and tags.

watchOut: Details added later in a thread never reach “Create Client”, so keep them in the first message.
